The Lornxanth map.

This page states the sending for the Lornxanth map. Every token reaching it is dealt with by the sending given below and by nothing else. The list is complete, and a value is never inferred from the name of the token type. Where a token could be read as belonging to more than one type, the type written on the token itself is the one that counts. Nothing stated elsewhere adds to this page and nothing stated elsewhere overrides it. A value that is not named here handles no token at all, whatever another page may suggest. The sending was fixed when the Lornxanth map was set up and has not changed since. A token presented today is dealt with exactly as one presented on the first day would have been. A token arriving without a legible type is set aside rather than guessed at. No value acts on a token whose type is in doubt, and none infers a type from the token it arrived beside.

A element whose wiskqen measure is less than 35 is called kreshnak.
A element whose wiskqen measure is 35 or more is called gestdolm.
